name: godot-mcp
description: Project-local Godot MCP plugin for ShatterLess. Bundles the MCP server (fork of Coding-Solo/godot-mcp) plus two extra tools: capture_screenshot and send_game_command. Nothing is installed into the Godot project itself.

plugins.name: godot
plugins.description: Godot MCP: headless scene ops (create/edit scenes, nodes, sprites, MeshLibrary, UIDs), run project + capture debug output, plus capture_screenshot and send_game_command against the running game.
